test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Read the sentence carefully and select the synonym of the underlined word from the given alternatives.**

As the effect of anaesthesia **__dissipated__** the patient regained consciousness.
solution: The correct answer is **"Disappeared."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"dissipated"** means to disappear or fade away. (धीरे-धीरे कम होते-होते ग़ायब हो जाना, समाप्त हो जाना; धारे-धीरे कमज़ोर हो कर ख़त्म हो जाना) • **Example:** *Eventually, his sorrow **dissipated**__.* • The sentence is saying that as the effect of anaesthesia disappeared, the patient regained consciousness. • The word **"disappeared"** means to become impossible to see or to find. (अदृश्‍य हो जाना, गायब हो जाना, खो जाना, मिल न पाना) __ • **Example**: *He walked away and **disappeared**__ into a crowd of people.* • **"Disappeared"** is a synonym of **"dissipated"** and is the closest in meaning to the underlined word. • So, the correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Enhanced** means to improve or increase. (बेहतर दिखने के लिए, किसी वस्‍तु में सुधार लाना) • **Heightened** means to make something more intense or extreme. (अधिक बड़ा या सशक्त हो जाना या बढ़ाना) • **Returned** means to come or go back to a place. (कहीं पहुँचना या लौटना) 1b8:T6e5, Here, the error lies in the part **"No sooner he was."**
